The qubit is driven about the $z$ axis. In terms of the Pauli matrix $\sigma_z$, whose square is the
identity, the rotation by a real angle $\theta$ reads
\begin{equation}
e^{-i\theta\sigma_z/2} = \cos\frac{\theta}{2} - i\sigma_z\sin\frac{\theta}{2} .
\label{eq:rot}
\end{equation}
